_meta.description: Stage 3 (Credentialized) for the Anaplan Overview foundational journey. Comprehension check via Academy course + persona pathway declaration. Completion of Stage 3 routes the resource to their persona-specific Foundations journey (Sales Foundations / Pre-Sales Foundations / Anaplan Platform → Delivery).
_meta._terminal_note: Stage 3 is the final stage of the Anaplan Overview foundational journey — there is no Stage 4 or 5. Completion of this stage marks the resource as having satisfied the universal Anaplan Overview prerequisite for every other journey.

_note: Stage 3 task structure is FIXED. Anaplan Overview Academy course content is the canonical comprehension check.
name: Credentialized
description: Resource demonstrates foundational Anaplan understanding by completing the Anaplan Overview Academy course (with quiz) and declares their persona pathway forward.

tasks.title: Anaplan Overview Academy course
tasks.description: Self-paced Academy course covering the foundational content from Stage 2 in a quiz-verified format. Acts as the comprehension check — confirms the resource has internalized Anaplan story, Connected Planning narrative, platform-at-a-glance, partner ecosystem, and customer success patterns. Includes a completion quiz.

tasks.title: Declare persona pathway forward
tasks.description: Final step: declare which persona pathway the resource is pursuing. This routes the resource to their next required journey: Sales → Connected Planning Sales Foundations; Pre-Sales → Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations; Delivery → Anaplan Platform foundational journey. Resource confirms their declared pathway with their manager (who was captured in Stage 1 profile).

_stage_entry_gates_note: No stage-entry verification — Stage 2 completion is the only prerequisite.

gates.description: Anaplan Overview Academy course completion confirmed (quiz passed)
Persona pathway declared (sales / pre-sales / delivery); resource is queued for the corresponding next journey

_estimated_effort_total_note: Light Stage 3 — Academy course + persona declaration. No labs, no senior-reviewer credential, no extension course (those exist for per-application journeys, not foundationals).
